name: Heartful Days
source:
Cultural festival approaches the day after tomorrow. Main character learns that he is going to be paired with female classmate for the treasure hunt during the festival, so he gives her a concerned look.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-january-2007-gekkou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
